name: stix
label: STIX 2.1 (Cybersecurity)
description: Structured Threat Intelligence Expression — used by every SIEM platform
short_description: Structured Threat Intelligence Expression — used by every SIEM platform
long_description: STIX 2.1 (Structured Threat Information Expression) is the OASIS standard for sharing cyber threat intelligence. The schema covers all STIX domain objects: identities (organizations), threat actors, indicators (detection patterns), malware definitions, vulnerability records, relationships between objects, and sighting events when indicators are observed.
when_to_use: Use for SIEM platforms, threat intelligence feeds, SOC (Security Operations Center) tools, or any security analytics application. Supported by Splunk, IBM QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, and all major SIEM vendors. MISP, OpenCTI, and TAXII servers all use STIX 2.1. Required for information sharing with ISACs (Information Sharing and Analysis Centers).

table_notes.stix_identity: Represents a named entity (person, organization, system) that produces, consumes, or is the subject of threat intelligence.
table_notes.stix_threat_actor: Describes an adversarial actor group or individual with associated tactics, motivations, and observed activity window.
table_notes.stix_indicator: Holds a detection pattern (STIX PATTERNING language) that, when matched, indicates malicious or suspicious activity.
table_notes.stix_malware: Catalogs malicious software families and instances including type classification, capabilities, and observed lifespan.
table_notes.stix_vulnerability: Records a specific software vulnerability, typically a CVE, with CVSS scoring and external reference links.
table_notes.stix_relationship: Directed edge connecting any two STIX domain objects with a typed relationship label (e.g. uses, indicates, targets).
table_notes.stix_sighting: Records an observed occurrence of a STIX indicator or other SDO, including where and how many times it was seen.

stix_identity.name: type
stix_identity.description: STIX object type; always 'identity' for rows in this table

stix_identity.name: name
stix_identity.description: Human-readable name of the identity (organization, person, or system)

stix_identity.name: identity_class
stix_identity.description: STIX identity-class OV: individual, group, system, organization, class, unknown

stix_identity.name: sectors
stix_identity.description: JSONB array of industry sectors (STIX industry-sector OV, e.g. ["finance", "government"])

stix_identity.name: contact_information
stix_identity.description: Free-text contact details (email, phone, address) for this identity

stix_identity.name: created_at
stix_identity.description: Timestamp when this STIX object was first created

stix_identity.name: modified_at
stix_identity.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this STIX object

stix_threat_actor.name: name
stix_threat_actor.description: Common name or designation for the threat actor (e.g. APT28, Lazarus Group)

stix_threat_actor.name: description
stix_threat_actor.description: Narrative description of the actor's background, history, and known activities

stix_threat_actor.name: threat_actor_types
stix_threat_actor.description: JSONB array of STIX threat-actor-type OV values (e.g. ["nation-state", "crime-syndicate"])

stix_threat_actor.name: aliases
stix_threat_actor.description: JSONB array of alternative names by which this actor is known across different vendors

stix_threat_actor.name: first_seen
stix_threat_actor.description: Earliest confirmed timestamp of activity attributed to this actor

stix_threat_actor.name: last_seen
stix_threat_actor.description: Most recent confirmed timestamp of activity attributed to this actor

stix_threat_actor.name: sophistication
stix_threat_actor.description: STIX sophistication OV: none, minimal, intermediate, advanced, expert, innovator, strategic

stix_threat_actor.name: resource_level
stix_threat_actor.description: STIX attack-resource-level OV: individual, club, contest, team, organization, government

stix_threat_actor.name: primary_motivation
stix_threat_actor.description: STIX attack-motivation OV for this actor's primary goal (e.g. espionage, financial-gain)

stix_threat_actor.name: secondary_motivations
stix_threat_actor.description: JSONB array of additional STIX attack-motivation OV values beyond the primary motivation

stix_indicator.name: name
stix_indicator.description: Short human-readable label for this indicator (e.g. 'Cobalt Strike C2 IP')

stix_indicator.name: description
stix_indicator.description: Analyst narrative explaining what this indicator detects and why it is significant

stix_indicator.name: indicator_types
stix_indicator.description: JSONB array of STIX indicator-type OV (e.g. ["malicious-activity", "compromised"])

stix_indicator.name: pattern
stix_indicator.description: Detection pattern in STIX PATTERNING language (e.g. [ipv4-addr:value = '1.2.3.4'])

stix_indicator.name: pattern_type
stix_indicator.description: Pattern language used; STIX patterning-type OV (stix, snort, yara, sigma, etc.)

stix_indicator.name: valid_from
stix_indicator.description: Timestamp from which this indicator is considered active and should trigger detections

stix_indicator.name: valid_until
stix_indicator.description: Timestamp after which this indicator should no longer trigger detections (NULL = indefinite)

stix_indicator.name: confidence
stix_indicator.description: Producer confidence in this indicator; 0-100 scale (100 = certain, 0 = no confidence)

stix_indicator.name: labels
stix_indicator.description: JSONB array of freeform label strings for ad-hoc categorization and filtering

stix_malware.name: name
stix_malware.description: Canonical name of the malware sample or family (e.g. WannaCry, Emotet)

stix_malware.name: description
stix_malware.description: Technical and operational description of how this malware functions and spreads

stix_malware.name: malware_types
stix_malware.description: JSONB array of STIX malware-type OV values (e.g. ["ransomware", "dropper"])

stix_malware.name: aliases
stix_malware.description: JSONB array of vendor-specific alternate names for this malware

stix_malware.name: is_family
stix_malware.description: True if this record describes a malware family rather than a specific sample

stix_malware.name: first_seen
stix_malware.description: Earliest known date this malware was observed in the wild

stix_malware.name: last_seen
stix_malware.description: Most recent date this malware was observed in the wild

stix_malware.name: capabilities
stix_malware.description: JSONB array of STIX malware-capabilities OV (e.g. ["exfiltrates-data", "persists-after-reboot"])

stix_malware.name: operating_system_refs
stix_malware.description: JSONB array of STIX software SCO IDs identifying targeted operating systems

stix_vulnerability.name: name
stix_vulnerability.description: Vulnerability name; typically the CVE identifier (e.g. CVE-2021-44228)

stix_vulnerability.name: description
stix_vulnerability.description: Technical description of the vulnerability, affected components, and exploitation conditions

stix_vulnerability.name: external_references
stix_vulnerability.description: JSONB array of STIX external-reference objects linking to NVD, vendor advisories, or exploits

stix_vulnerability.name: cvss_score
stix_vulnerability.description: CVSS base score (0.0-10.0); higher values indicate greater severity

stix_vulnerability.name: cvss_vector
stix_vulnerability.description: CVSS vector string encoding attack vector, complexity, privileges, and impact metrics

stix_vulnerability.name: cve_id
stix_vulnerability.description: CVE identifier (format: CVE-YYYY-NNNNN) for cross-referencing NVD and vendor databases

stix_vulnerability.name: created_at
stix_vulnerability.description: Timestamp when this STIX vulnerability object was first created

stix_vulnerability.name: modified_at
stix_vulnerability.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this vulnerability record

stix_relationship.name: relationship_type
stix_relationship.description: STIX relationship-type OV label (e.g. uses, indicates, targets, attributed-to, mitigates)

stix_relationship.name: source_ref
stix_relationship.description: STIX ID of the source (subject) SDO; references any STIX domain object by its id

stix_relationship.name: target_ref
stix_relationship.description: STIX ID of the target (object) SDO; references any STIX domain object by its id

stix_relationship.name: description
stix_relationship.description: Analyst narrative clarifying the nature or evidence basis of this relationship

stix_relationship.name: start_time
stix_relationship.description: Timestamp from which this relationship is known to have been active

stix_relationship.name: stop_time
stix_relationship.description: Timestamp after which this relationship is no longer considered active (NULL = ongoing)

stix_relationship.name: confidence
stix_relationship.description: Producer confidence in this relationship; 0-100 scale (100 = certain)

stix_sighting.name: sighting_of_ref
stix_sighting.description: STIX ID of the SDO that was sighted (typically an indicator or threat-actor)

stix_sighting.name: count
stix_sighting.description: Number of times this sighting was observed within the first_seen to last_seen window

stix_sighting.name: first_seen
stix_sighting.description: Earliest timestamp at which this sighting was observed

stix_sighting.name: last_seen
stix_sighting.description: Most recent timestamp at which this sighting was observed

stix_sighting.name: observed_data_refs
stix_sighting.description: JSONB array of STIX observed-data SCO IDs containing the raw data supporting this sighting

stix_sighting.name: where_sighted_refs
stix_sighting.description: JSONB array of STIX identity IDs for organizations that observed this sighting

stix_sighting.name: summary
stix_sighting.description: True if this is an aggregate sighting summary rather than a discrete observation event
